# Diego Cornejo

> SRE, DevOps engineer and software architect. Cloud infrastructure and SaaS platforms for telecom and connected devices, down to LoRaWAN integrations and binary payload decoding.

Most of my work lives between the device and the cloud: getting data off the radio, making sense of it and running the platforms that depend on it.

- IoT and protocol engineering: LoRa and LoRaWAN integrations, The Things Stack, binary payload decoding, protocol analysis, telemetry processing.
- SaaS and telecom platforms: APIs, distributed systems and web applications (Node.js, TypeScript, Python, React, PostgreSQL, Redis), including LLM features like RAG and agents.
- Cloud, SRE and networking: AWS, Azure, Oracle Cloud, Vercel, Cloudflare, Kubernetes, Terraform, Prometheus; monitoring, incident analysis, routing, VPNs, firewalls, DNS and authentication.

- [Home](https://diegocornejo.com/): profile, areas of work and contact

## Open source

- [LoRa Packet Decoder](https://lora-packet.vercel.app): web app that decodes LoRaWAN packets, including with your own session keys
- [Tektelic to TTS](https://github.com/diegofcornejo/tektelic-to-tts): migrates LoRaWAN devices from Tektelic to The Things Stack using ABP
- [GitHub](https://github.com/diegofcornejo): other projects
